subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should the remaining Feishu startup timeout be fixed by changing the startup bot-info preflight behavior, or should this issue wait for live proof that current main still reproduces the startup delay?
rationale: The QR half is already repaired on main, but the remaining startup half touches Feishu auth/readiness semantics and needs owner intent before changing probe timing, deferral, or fallback behavior.

options.title: Keep as startup tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical remaining Feishu startup-timeout tracker, require live Windows/Feishu proof, and decide the preflight behavior before implementation.

options.title: Close after live no-repro
options.body: Close only if a maintainer or contributor proves current main or a shipped release no longer shows the Feishu startup timeout on the reported setup.

options.title: Split startup follow-up
options.body: Close the QR portion as fixed on main and open a narrower Feishu startup-preflight issue with the required live proof and owner decision recorded there.

recommendation.title: Keep as startup tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical remaining Feishu startup-timeout tracker, require live Windows/Feishu proof, and decide the preflight behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The package declares this handle as the Feishu community maintainer and the issue timeline already routed the report to them.
